title: Komyo-ji — The Evening Bell
description: An autumn Buddhist temple above a recessed koi pond. A vermilion arched bridge leads to the open golden Buddha hall; a saffron-robed attendant waits beside the suspended bell and timber striker. Broad curved irimoya eaves, paper screens, golden shibi, stone lanterns and an asymmetric maple canopy complete the monastery garden.
